title: Modern Changelog, Live Healthcheck Status Page & Automated CI/CD Release Pipeline
summary: Introduced customer-facing Changelog and real-time System Status pages, detailed backend health diagnostics for PostgreSQL and Redis, and automated GitHub Actions CI/CD release tagging upon merging pull requests to main.

changes.text: Interactive Changelog page (/changelog) with real-time search, category filtering, and visual release timeline
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Real-time System Status page (/status) with 90-day uptime calendar and interactive connection latency probe
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Automated GitHub Actions release workflow (.github/workflows/release-changelog.yml) generating tags and notes from conventional commits
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Detailed backend health diagnostic probe (/api/v1/health/detailed) measuring database and Redis roundtrip latency
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Configured automated production deployment triggered from main branch within the GitHub production environment
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Timezone-safe release date formatting to consistently display September 21, 2026 across all client locales
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Sub-2ms healthcheck latency response times for PostgreSQL connection queries and Redis ping probes
